name: Away with You
source:
Maki Amajiki, a loner who attends the same academy as Awaki Yamaguchi, makes friends with two boys at a pond one day. The reason? Maybe it was fate?

Go through a short story with Maki and his adventures into the world of friendship, which is completely new to him. 

[From [url=https://ananonymousflower.itch.io/away-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
